description: This file defines a class named ChronologicalEvictionStrategy implementing an eviction strategy based on message age for a caching system within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It manages buffers, performs purges based on age criteria, and reports cache metrics.

classes.name: ChronologicalEvictionStrategy
classes.description: Implements an age-based eviction strategy for cached data, managing buffers and purging messages based on age thresholds using a provided predicate.

methods.name: PerformPurge
methods.description: Performs cache purge based on current time, calling internal purge logic and executing periodic monitoring.

methods.name: OnBlockAllocated
methods.description: Handles the allocation of a new buffer block, updating internal buffers and cache size metrics.

methods.name: ShouldPurge
methods.description: Determines whether a cached message should be purged based on its age relative to the newest message.

methods.name: PerformPurgeInternal
methods.description: Internal method executing the purge operation, removing messages deemed old enough for purging based on the predicate.

methods.name: FreePurgedBuffers
methods.description: Releases buffers associated with purged messages and updates cache size metrics.

methods.name: ReportCacheSize
methods.description: Reports current cache size to the monitor.
